summary: Story no longer empty: four well-formed leaves (WI-07a telemetry, WI-07b reachability/scarcity, WI-07c numerical tuning, WI-07d 60 FPS verification) each carry strictly fewer of the four parent criteria (1/1/2/1) with all criteria text verbatim and union covering AC-bal-timing, AC-bal-scarcity, AC-bal-flow, AC-bal-perf. Each leaf changes at most three named responsibilities within a strict subsystem subset and serves one independently testable behavior; WI-07b (section 32 validators + route scenarios + scarcity placement) and WI-07c (difficulty curve, density/travel, tutorial pacing config) sit exactly at the responsibility limit but remain single-behavior, config-bounded items. Dependency order is correct: ST-07 depends on existing ST-06, WI-07a/WI-07b are parallel, WI-07d depends on WI-07a, WI-07c depends on WI-07a+WI-07b; no ancestor/descendant dependencies. Every criterion has one named final proof owner (WI-07c for timing and flow, WI-07b for scarcity, WI-07d for perf) and cross-child proof is explicit (timing closes only on recorded playtest evidence after WI-07a records and WI-07b proves reachability). Evidence is focused per leaf (schema-parity Node test, live-check fixtures, before/after frame data, spoiler-safe reports) and each handoff names concrete files and request sections so a fresh implementer can proceed. This supersedes the prior split receipt, which flagged the story as empty.
